title: AMD: Over 20 Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495 Devices to Launch Soon, Mini PCs Becoming the Main Force
excerpt: AMD signaled at the Ryzen AI Max media salon: over 20 devices based on the Ryzen AI Max+ PRO495 processor platform will be launched in the near future. The mode
content_html:
AMD signaled at the Ryzen AI Max media salon: over 20 devices based on the Ryzen AI Max+ PRO495 processor platform will be launched in the near future. The models that appeared this time are mostly in the mini PC form factor, with HP being the exception — it will bring a new generation of ZBook Ultra mobile workstations based on "Gorgon Halo."

In the known specific models, Mingfan presented N5MAX-P495 and MS-S1MAX-P495, Jimo Ke launched EVO-X5Pro, and Lenovo contributed ThinkCentre X Ultra. These products have already appeared in public reports; for example, there were earlier versions of the "Strix Halo" generation like Xiwei R1Max. From the lineup distribution, it is clear that AMD aims to push the high-performance mini PC market further forward with this PRO495, making mini PCs the absolute star of this product line.
